matthew.4.p1.b1.text: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

matthew.4.p1.b2.text: After fasting forty days and forty nights,

matthew.4.p2.b1.text: The tempter came to Him and said,

matthew.4.p2.b2.text: “If You are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.”

matthew.4.p2.b4.text: “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’”

matthew.4.p3.b1.text: Then the devil took Him to the holy city and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple.

matthew.4.p3.b2.text: “If You are the Son of God, … throw Yourself down.

matthew.4.p3.b3.text: For it is written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You, and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’”

matthew.4.p3.b4.text: “It is also written: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’”

matthew.4.p4.b1.text: Again, the devil took Him to a very high mountain and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.

matthew.4.p4.b2.text: “All this I will give You, … if You will fall down and worship me.”

matthew.4.p4.b4.text: “For it is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’”

matthew.4.p5.b2.text: and angels came and ministered to Him.

matthew.4.p5.b3.text: When Jesus heard that John had been imprisoned, He withdrew to Galilee.

matthew.4.p6.b1.text: Leaving Nazareth, He went and lived in Capernaum,

matthew.4.p6.b4.text: on those living in the land of the shadow of death, a light has dawned.”

matthew.4.p7.b1.text: From that time on Jesus began to preach,

matthew.4.p7.b2.text: “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.”

matthew.4.p8.b1.text: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, He saw two brothers,

matthew.4.p8.b2.text: Simon called Peter and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

matthew.4.p8.b3.text: “Come, follow Me, … and I will make you fishers of men.”

matthew.4.p8.b4.text: And at once they left their nets and followed Him.

matthew.4.p9.b1.text: Going on from there, He saw two other brothers, James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat with their father Zebedee, mending their nets.

matthew.4.p9.b3.text: and immediately they left the boat and their father and followed Him.

matthew.4.p10.b1.text: Jesus went throughout Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness among the people.

matthew.4.p10.b2.text: News about Him spread all over Syria, and people brought to Him all who were ill …

matthew.4.p10.b4.text: The large crowds that followed Him came from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and beyond the Jordan.
